workflows.title: DFT mode resource contract
workflows.stage: DFT mode setup / DFT resource acceptance / DFT at-speed test handoff
workflows.decision: Review DFT mode prerequisites and at-speed recipe, clock and exception alignment before test handoff.
intent_questions: Which independently required test phases and authorized access policy need clock, reset, enable and power resources?
Which actual native connectivity, consumed constraints and shift/capture observations establish those resources without bypassing policy?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: At-speed launch/capture constraint alignment
workflows.decision: Review at-speed launch/capture constraint alignment through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which original launch/capture recipe, mode and control-history requirements define this at-speed handoff?
Which actual native clock/exception populations and observed OCC pulses apply, while ATPG and physical pulse-quality claims remain separate?
